newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran quake toll reaches 58 - agency.
newsitem.headline: Iran quake toll reaches 58 - agency.

text.p: The death toll in two earthquakes in northeastern Iran rose to 58 on Wednesday, the official Iranian news agency IRNA reported.
It said 153 people were injured. A total of 14 villages had been levelled and 45 others badly damaged in Tuesday's quakes, one registering 5.6 on the Richter scale and the other 6.1.

IRNA quoted Hassan Movahedian, governor of the provincial city of Bojnurd about 580 km (360 miles) northeast of Tehran, as saying there was no news from several villages because connecting roads had been cut off by the quakes.
The quakes had their epicentre outside Bojnurd, near the border with Turkmenistan and Iran's Caspian coast.
The head of the geophysics institute of Mashhad University said it registered more than 100 aftershocks in nine hours on Tuesday.

The governor said 500 tents, 4,000 blankets, five tonnes of rice, two tonnes of sugar, tea and vegetable oil as well as considerable amounts of clothing and heaters were immediately sent to the stricken region.
